title: A finiteness result on representations of the profinite étale Nori fundamental group
summary: Let $(X,x)$ be a pointed geometrically connected smooth projective variety over a sub-$p$-adic field $k$. For any given rank $n$, we prove that there are only finitely many isomorphism classes of representations $π_{1}^{N}(X,x)\rightarrow \mathrm{GL}_{n}$, where $π_{1}^{N}(X,x)$ is the Nori fundamental group of essentially finite bundles. Equivalently, there are only finitely many isomorphism classes of essentially finite bundles of rank $n$. This answers a question from Gasbarri. We also discuss analogues of this finiteness result in characteristic $p>0$.
